source_notes.locked_full: Threat is expressed through deep hook; layered crown plates with smaller fittings; orbital ring enclosed by asymmetrical armor; cheek opening has curved armor boundaries and visible internal workings; throat-to-breast breaks into short irregular overlapping plates with exposed machinery on side. Shoulder compact. Whole character is dense and richly broken up rather than smooth or orderly.
source_notes.july_head_only: Forehead sweep, beak-root panels, deeply inset round optic with nested rings, irregular cheek armor and aperture edges form a continuous aggressive head design. Hardware is integrated into overlapping metal sheets, not isolated dots. Body excluded.

baseline09_notes.whole: Avian outline and strong legs read, but broad pale forehead cap and smooth black bill dominate; round protruding optic lacks surrounding construction. Dense shoulder scales contrast with long smooth vertical breast plates. Complete bird remains sparse/orderly relative to canon.
baseline09_notes.head: Oversized smooth forehead cap floats over open void at bill root; optic ring sits forward as thick isolated circle. Cheek mostly slender curved rails and dark empty aperture; diagonal tube-like mandible. Crown blades sparse and regular.
baseline09_notes.side: Long straight breast plates emphasize thin upright stretched neck/breast. Hook/bill narrow from this view; head separate from throat through large void. Compact shoulder rear acceptable but generic orderly scales.
baseline09_notes.rear: Existing broad hollow opening in back of head, narrow repeating nape strip and laterally hanging rails. Smooth central back surrounded by fine regular scales; crown bridging looks unfinished.
